title: understudy.review_policy.v1
description: Optional review-policy.json sidecar next to a foundry manifest.json (understudy.trace_foundry.v1), configuring the exception-review auto-accept bar for that benchmark. A sidecar rather than a manifest field: the manifest is machine-written and regenerated on rebuilds, while this policy is operator-owned post-generation state (same ownership split as reviews.jsonl / feedback.jsonl). An absent, unreadable, or wrong-schema file means the defaults (min_confidence 'high', require_incumbent_pass true, default_decision 'accept'). Readers apply recognized fields individually and ignore unrecognized values (a typo must not silently loosen the bar). Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this policy shape.

min_confidence.description: Lowest machine_confidence that can auto-accept (ordered high > medium > low; default high). A close_call task is always an exception regardless of this bar.

require_incumbent_pass.description: When true (default), a task the incumbent failed in the calibration rerun cannot auto-accept (reason incumbent_failed). Set false to drop the incumbent gate from the auto-accept policy.

default_decision.description: Effective decision for a task that has NO reviews.jsonl line (default 'accept'). 'accept': generated tasks are born accepted; machine signals (low confidence, self-check, incumbent failure, schema conflict, anomaly) surface as attention flags rather than acceptance blockers, and reviews.jsonl carries explicit human overrides only. 'pending': the pre-inbox flow — unreviewed tasks await an explicit accept (human or applied auto-accept) before counting as accepted.
